description: Kind-directed pending payload validation through a generated crate: gen schema generates a committed self-contained schema whose contribution payload binds under from-kind, so its shape is selected by the kind the referenced setting holds, twice into scratch trees the harness requires byte-identical; the generated crate compiles inside a scratch workspace materialized from this scenario's committed template. The compiled processor, naming every kdlith type it spells through the generated crate alone, collects a committed data document as a reading linked under complete scope through its generated reader: each payload streams as a pending item with its raw value, a number for a number setting and one of a choice setting's choices pass, a Bool for the number setting fails KDLITH-REF005, and the payload whose reference resolves to nothing fails KDLITH-REF001 alone, its payload never validated, the link diagnostic before the payload diagnostic, and the reading fails; linked under local scope the same diagnostics are reported and the reading does not fail, each as vet data reports it on the same input
